item.title: Incumbent Sen. Ed Markey wins Massachusetts' Democratic primary for US Senate
item.description: Bucking a push for younger leadership this election season, Sen. Ed Markey, 80, won the Democratic nomination against Rep. Seth Moulton, 47, who said that his party needed new leaders.
item.content:encoded:
Bucking a push for younger leadership this election season, Sen. Ed Markey, 80, won the Democratic nomination against Rep. Seth Moulton, 47, who said that his party needed new leaders.

(Image credit: Andrew Harnik)

item.title: North Carolina Rep. Chuck Edwards is formally censured over harassment allegations
item.description: The censure vote drew bipartisan support, and followed an investigation by the House Ethics Committee into allegations of sexual harassment against two young female staff members.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Trump's pro-data center stance is putting pressure on Republicans ahead of midterms
item.description: Trump's pro-data center stance is out of step with voters. Republicans are trying to navigate the issue but it's putting them at odds with the president's AI agenda.

item.title: ICE says it has enough body cameras now, after series of deadly shootings
item.description: Cameras could help alleviate some concerns about ICE transparency and accountability after immigration officers were involved in over two dozen shootings under the Trump administration.

item.title: USPS 'carefully reviewing' whistleblower claim on plan for Trump's mail in voting order
item.description: A whistleblower says the U.S. Postal Service is rushing out an online system for President Trump's push to restrict mail voting that could "derail" the midterm election if courts allow it to proceed.

item.title: Judge rules man accused in Charlie Kirk murder case will stand trial, facing possible death penalty
item.description: Utah District Judge Tony Graf heard arguments over evidence introduced in July, to decide whether there was enough probable cause for a trial in the shooting of the conservative activist last year.

item.description: A rematch in a swing district Pennsylvania is showcasing how Republican messaging from 2024 is getting a replay, this time from Democratic candidates.

item.title: Trump officials cut political interference ban after unusual Census Bureau report
item.description: After the Census Bureau issued a report tied to a Trump-aligned think tank, the bureau's parent agency cut language banning political interference from its scientific integrity policy, NPR learned.
